There are two main processes that contribute to changes in land use. Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Deforestation is the process of forest land being cleared, often to make space for agriculture.
Urbanisation involves rural areas being converted into an urban space.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: These changes in land use can be very damaging to the environment. For example, both deforestation and urbanisation are very destructive to animal habitats, which can reduce biodiversity in many ecosystems.
These two processes also increase pollution, which is the introduction of harmful materials into the environment. This contributes to climate change, which has a very negative effect on the planet.
